root_causes: The dev split was Vietnamese-only while the test split was predominantly English, so the lexical-heavy confidence score did not generalize.
The eight-document corpus left no untouched source group after the failed holdout was opened.
Dense retrieval reached a near-ceiling test Recall@5, making a two-point hybrid gain impossible on that candidate.
remediation: Do not reuse the rejected RC1 holdout as RC2 release evidence.
Expand the real corpus from 8 to 13 documents using five pre-existing repository PDFs.
Assign source-disjoint RC2 dev/test/holdout groups in the corpus manifest.
Place the English source in dev for multilingual calibration and reserve newly indexed sources for test and holdout.
